source: decal-series.js: ECharts 6.1 dist, SSR svg, 600 x 400
notes: tiles: the decal symbols decal-aria.js left out -- empty, path://, image:// -- as the SVG painter received them
scenarios: every displayable whose decal element fills, by series / dataType / dataIndex, and the legend icons

scenarios.note: a radar area takes the item decal through its area style; a series without an area draws none; the points are symbols
aria: every node the decal of its depth-1 ancestor, a scope of its own; without aria the series' and the nodes' own
the content rects: aria by the depth-1 ancestor; without aria the series' and the nodes' own
candlestick bodies and boxplot boxes wear the item's decal
a heatmap's cells on a grid and on a calendar
a pictorial bar's symbols, repeated or not
a graph's nodes are symbols, its edges do not fill: nothing
sankey nodes; edges coloured by their source or target take that node's decal
chord pieces; edges coloured by their source take that node's decal
a themeRiver layer takes the style of its last row
a gauge's pointer and progress take the item's decal
a renderItem's path with api.visual('decal'); a decal written in renderItem; a text and a stroke-only path take none
a large bar's batch path wears the series' decal
a line's own legend icon: the marker wears the decal, an empty marker too; a bar's default icon

anchors.name: radar: an area per item of the area series, none on the other; the points wear it either way (createSymbol)
radar: the own areaStyle of an item shows its area
legend-line: the empty marker wears one
custom: the text and the polyline take none
sunburst: the second sunburst starts its own scope, walking its sorted children
tiles: an empty symbol is filled white and stroked 2
